jobs.title: Enlistment Waiver Specialist (Ohio Army National Guard)
jobs.description_text: Job Summary: The Enlistment Waiver Specialist supports the Ohio Army National Guard Recruiting and Retention Battalion (RRB) at Beightler Armory by reviewing, preparing, and tracking enlistment waivers (medical, moral, administrative, and prior service) and Military Entrance Processing Station (MEPS) physical requests using national systems. At its core, this is a regulatory quality assurance role: you are the quality check on an applicant’s packet before it goes forward for a decision, verifying every entry against source documentation and current Army and National Guard accession regulations and returning what does not comply. Recruiters and NCOICs will rely on you for clear, well-supported answers on what the regulations allow, often on short timelines. The role also researches and maintains personnel records for current and former military members. Please Note: This position is contingent upon award (Nov/Dec 2026) Key Responsibilities: Medical Waiver Processing: Receive, review, and prepare medical waivers and MEPS physical requests using the Medical Actions Tracking System (MATS). Submit processed waivers to the Chief Surgeon at NGB-ARS and track status through final adjudication. Upon return of waivers, execute workflows in the National Guidance Counselor Resource Center System (NGCRC). jobs.title: Associate Director, Marketing
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo’s Commercial team is building the strategy, insights, brand and infrastructure required to bring LX2006 to patients – marking Lexeo’s transition from a clinical-stage to a commercial company. We are seeking an Associate Director, Marketing to play a central role in preparing for the launch of LX2006, Lexeo’s first commercial product, anticipated in the US in 2028 and globally thereafter. Reporting to the Senior Director, Marketing, this individual will serve as the LX2006 brand lead, owning critical launch workstreams end to end – from customer insights and competitive intelligence to market development, campaigns, customer targeting and launch readiness – and working closely with cross-functional partners in Market Access/HEOR, Medical Affairs, Patient Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Legal, CMC, and Business Development (ad hoc) as part of Lexeo’s Launch Readiness Team. The role will also support early commercial planning for LX2020, Lexeo’s gene therapy candidate for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy. This is a highly visible, hands-on opportunity to build a launch from the ground up and help shape the commercial foundation of a growing clinical stage company. jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is seeking a hands-on in vivo pharmacologist to build rodent models of cardiac disease and use them to de-risk targets, screen therapeutic candidates and advance our discovery pipeline. The scientist will design, perform or manage rodent studies from target validation through hit identification, working cross-functionally with In Vitro Pharmacology, Modality Engineering, and Translational Sciences to select-advance molecules. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, Modality Engineering
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is hiring a hands-on Modality Engineering Scientist to design, synthesize, and characterize oligonucleotides, bioconjugates, and AAV therapeutics for our discovery pipeline. The scientist will advance molecules from design through analytical characterization and handoff to in vitro and in vivo teams, working across chemistry, molecular biology, and pharmacology. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.description_text: Role Summary We are seeking a highly collaborative, hands-on Scientist II to help establish a preclinical neuroscience laboratory supporting small-molecule and protein therapeutics. The role will also build fit-for-purpose human neuronal models, laboratory workflows, and external partnerships. Location We welcome applications from candidates located across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.

The initial focus will be leading execution of LTA’s company-wide L&D infrastructure work, including the training inventory, LMS evaluation and implementation, and company-wide rollout. The role will also coordinate ongoing L&D training and support the Manager Efficacy Program.

jobs.description_text: Avionics Engineer DESCRIPTION Avionics Engineers play a critical role in mission success, integrating hardware that generates thousands of pounds of thrust with software that ensures precise guidance and control. This is the lowest-to-highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Director, Autonomous Systems
jobs.description_text: Director, Autonomous Systems DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking a Director of Autonomous Systems to lead the software, guidance, navigation, and control (GNC), autonomy, and simulation capabilities that underpin the Cyclops interceptor and RSX target vehicle programs. This leader will own the technical strategy and execution required to transform mission objectives into reliable, flight-ready systems. The role combines deep technical leadership with team building and cross-functional execution, spanning algorithms, modeling and simulation, embedded software, perception, autonomy, and vehicle-level integration. Successful candidates will know how to move quickly without compromising engineering rigor. They will guide system-level trades, establish scalable technical foundations, and help teams deliver exceptional performance using cost-effective, producible hardware. In hit-to-kill missile defense, every millisecond matters. This role offers the opportunity to build the team and technology responsible for making those milliseconds count. The compensation range for this role is $220,000 - $290,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

We specialize in ballistic missile defense and are developing Cyclops, a low-cost, mass-producible interceptor. We also produce containerized launchers and offer low-cost targets for threat replication. The future of global security depends on defensive technology that redefines cost, magazine depth, and distribution to deter and defend against evolving threats. Join us. The best engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals make their teammates better, knowing that complementary skills create force multiplication and drive mission success. jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer

jobs.title: Sales Specialist – AI Products
jobs.description_text: Kpler's AI products are changing how commodity and maritime professionals access and interpret market intelligence. Through our AI surfaces, MCP server, which can be used within tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and enterprise copilots, and our AI Assistant embedded in the Kpler terminal, customers can ask questions in natural language and receive analysis grounded in Kpler data. We are looking for a technically minded, customer-facing Sales Specialist – AI Products to support the adoption and growth of Kpler's AI offering globally. You will work closely with prospects and existing customers, demonstrating how our AI products can address their specific needs, integrate into their existing technology environments and deliver tangible commercial value. Reporting to the Dry Bulk Sales Specialist Team Lead, this role requires a proactive, commercially driven individual who is motivated by achieving and exceeding revenue targets.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst (Companies/Ownership)
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Data Analyst within our Data Platform team, you will be the subject matter expert behind Kpler’s company and ownership datasets. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, structure and ongoing development of company-level data, including ownership, management, operator and corporate hierarchy information. Your deep understanding of the maritime industry and its corporate landscape will help establish a reliable source of truth for asset ownership, supporting our wider data platform strategy and enabling other datasets, products and teams to build on consistent, trusted information. Starting with maritime companies, you will help expand our coverage over time to include other asset classes and related industries, such as ports, terminals, refineries, commodities and infrastructure. You will use your industry judgement to lead complex data investigations, identify gaps and drive improvements in data quality and coverage with a high degree of independence. While technical data skills are important, this role places particular emphasis on your industry expertise and ability to translate complex ownership structures into clear business rules and reliable data models. You will also collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Market Analysts and other Data Analysts to strengthen our data capabilities and support commercial and customer-facing teams.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior Data Engineer on our Maritime Models team, you will take technical ownership of the core data pipelines and distributed storage architectures powering Kpler's vessel tracking and predictive analytics. You will design, scale, and optimize high-throughput batch and streaming pipelines that ingest raw maritime telemetry and transform it into actionable intelligence. Working with distributed NoSQL systems like Apache HBase at scale, your work directly ensures the freshness, accuracy, and reliability of the data models our global customers depend on.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Financial Flows
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior Data Engineer on the Financial Flows team, you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end data pipelines, predictive models, and cloud infrastructure powering Kpler’s commodity finance analytics. You will lead the modernization of our data foundation, spearheading the migration of production services to AWS and re-architecting legacy calculation engines into clean, performant Python services. Operating at the crossroads of quantitative research and cloud infrastructure, your work will directly ensure that market participants receive real-time, mission-critical insights across global commodities markets.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning. The Location: Headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The Backin

jobs.title: Director of User Experience (UX)
jobs.description_text: Your role in our mission The Director of User Experience (UX) serves as the primary visionary and operational leader for the UX organization. This role is responsible for shaping the overarching design strategy, optimizing DesignOps, integrating emerging technologies like AI, and ensuring seamless cross-functional alignment. Blending high-level organizational leadership with hands-on management, the UX Director ensures that teams deliver desirable, viable, and feasible user experiences that deeply connect with the company’s brand identity and drive Product initiatives forward. Compensation details: The salary for this position is $190k - $237k annually, plus bonus and generous benefits.

jobs.title: Director, Collections Strategy & Analytics
jobs.description_text: Your Role in Our Mission At Prosper, we are committed to advancing financial well-being through smarter, technology-driven financial solutions. We are seeking an exceptional leader to head our Analytics function within the Collections & Recoveries organization. As the Director, Collections Strategy & Analytics, you will serve as a strategic leader responsible for optimizing portfolio credit performance across our Personal Loans and Credit Card business lines. Reporting directly to the VP of Collections & Recoveries, you will lead and empower high-performing analytics teams to design, test, and deploy data-driven strategies across the entire credit lifecycle. Leveraging modern data stacks, machine learning, and advanced behavioral segmentation, you will drive collection effectiveness, elevate operational efficiency, and deliver a best-in-class customer experience. Compensation details: The salary for this position is $230,000 - $287,000 annually, plus bonus and generous benefits.

jobs.title: Manager, Engineering
jobs.description_text: Your role in our mission We are looking for an engineering leader dedicated to fostering people growth, platform advancement and organization development. You'll lead one of the teams that build Prosper's credit card and personal loan experiences. Our teams own customer-facing web and mobile apps, card products, payments, the shared platforms our products run on, and the tools and AI/ML systems that support our customer service operations. You'll guide your team in the design, development, and delivery of high-quality software that meets business objectives. You'll foster a collaborative and innovative environment, mentor engineers, manage project execution, and ensure the adoption of engineering best practices. The ideal candidate has strong technical knowledge and thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Above all other factors, we are looking for smart, driven candidates who want to be part of a culture of innovation and creativity as we lead within the fintech and marketplace lending industry. Compensation details: The salary for this position is $200,000 - $220,000 annually, plus bonus and generous benefits.

jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description_text: Your role in our mission Prosper is looking for a talented People Operations Manager to join the People & Places team. This person will oversee HR operations, employee lifecycle processes, and the HR technology stack. This person is data-driven and detail oriented, strives to make processes efficient, and is system savvy. This role reports to our Director, Total Rewards & People Operations, and will have one direct report. Compensation details: The salary for this position is $129k - 160k annually, plus bonus and generous benefits.

jobs.title: Sr. Lifecycle Marketing Specialist
jobs.description_text: Your role in our mission We’re seeking an experienced professional to join our Lifecycle Marketing team. The Senior Lifecycle Marketing Specialist is responsible for both the management and execution of multi-channel lifecycle marketing campaigns. The ideal candidate has lifecycle marketing experience, managing and executing email, SMS, push, and in-account messaging campaigns using a modern marketing automation platform. This is a great opportunity for someone who has a customer-first mindset and is seeking to grow in a fast-paced and challenging environment, in a position that directly impacts Prosper’s bottom line. This is a critical role with high expectations and zero room for error. Compensation details: The salary for this position is $116,000 - $144,000 annually, plus bonus and generous benefits.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description_text: We’re Quandri, our mission at Quandri is to transform insurance into a trusted and delightful experience using AI. What we doQuandri brings deeply specific, vertically-focused AI to the industry’s most critical stakeholders:insurance agencies and brokerages. Why join us?This is a rare seat. You will build Quandri’s partnerships function from the ground up, own some of the company’s most important distribution growth bets, and report directly to the CEO with a real say in the company’s strategy. You will define how this function works rather than inherit someone else's playbook, and you will have the equity, the mandate, and the runway to make it matter. About the RoleQuandri is seeking a Sales Development Representative to join our team. The Sales Development team at Quandri is often the first point of contact for many of our target customers. Your mission will be to build excitement about Quandri throughout the insurance brokerage and agency marketplace, and provide value to prospects right from the outset. The ideal candidate for this position is flexible and adaptable with the ability to fulfill a variety of functions.

jobs.title: Director of Field Marketing
jobs.description_text: About the role As Director of Field Marketing at Quandri reporting to the CMO, you’ll establish the strategy, operating rhythms, and measurement needed to generate demand for Quandri’s software in our first priority regions. As the program grows, you’ll hire and lead marketers dedicated to individual regions. You’ll work closely with regional Sales teams to understand their markets, target accounts, and pipeline goals. You’ll turn those priorities into a focused mix of hosted events, sponsored conferences, executive dinners, meetups, local digital programs, and other tactics you think are relevant and meaningful. The industry is insurance, and the events are fun: think golf tournaments, baseball games, community get-togethers and more. This is a hands-on role: you’ll set the direction and personally deliver programs while building the team. You will: Build the field marketing plan for Quandri’s first defined regions, deciding where to invest and developing repeatable programs that can scale. Manage field events from start to finish, including venues, vendors, staffing, on-site materials, and execution. For each major event, agree with Sales on the accounts to reach, meetings to book, and opportunities to advance. Plan outreach before the event, secure clear next steps during it, and ensure timely, personalized follow-up is recorded in HubSpot. Set goals for meetings, qualified opportunities, and sourced and influenced pipeline. Report results and use them to refine the plan.

jobs.description_text: We’ve built a platform that is reshaping how insurance agencies operate. You’ll develop a deep understanding of insurance agencies, their buying decisions, and the work our software changes. You’ll turn those insights into clear messaging that connects product capabilities to business outcomes. Reporting to the CMO, you’ll lead the function with a hands-on mandate. You’ll establish the frameworks and operating rhythms for product marketing while writing, launching, testing, and refining the work yourself. As the company grows, you’ll help build the team to support an expanding product portfolio. You will: Lead positioning and messaging for Quandri’s platform in partnership with the CMO. Make its value clear across workflows, buyer groups, markets, and pricing tiers while keeping the overall story coherent. Build a regular practice of customer and prospect research. Insurance agents are the lifeblood of the insurance industry, and are where most Property & Casualty insurance is sold and serviced. Yet there are forces making it harder than ever for them to operate: more consolidation, a rising talent crisis, and the increasing complexity of insurance and the AI revolution. This challenge is a massive opportunity to rethink how insurance agencies operate. Quandri is at the cutting edge of this change, delivering transformation to the entire insurance experience one process at a time through a deep understanding of insurance workflows, systems, and data, paired with deep technical capabilities and proprietary models. jobs.description_text: About the Role You will help reinvent how Quandri's teams operate by combining a deep understanding of their work with practical knowledge of what AI can do. Your customers are our teams across Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Implementation, Finance, Operations, Product and Engineering. jobs.title: Development Coach - Dominican Republic Academy
jobs.description_text: DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW: The Player Development department is dedicated to fostering the comprehensive growth of our minor league players. Our mission is to excel in optimizing talent and skill development while aligning with player and team objectives. Our approach involves the creation of world class player programs and efficiently scaling them across our player pool. Collaborating closely with baseball analytics, performance, and medical, we establish effective frameworks for experimentation and learning. Additionally, we work closely with Amateur Scouting, International Scouting, and Pro Scouting to ensure seamless player transitions into the Red Sox organization. POSITION OVERVIEW : The Academy Development Coach will support player development at the Dominican Republic Academy by operating baseball technology, ensuring reliable data collection, and helping translate performance information into actionable development priorities. Working closely with Academy Staff, Roving Coordinators, and Baseball Analytics, this role will help monitor progress toward individual player development goals. The ideal candidate communicates effectively in English and Spanish, is comfortable working with data and technology, and builds strong relationships with players and staff. The position also provides opportunities to participate in on-field instruction and develop coaching skills.

jobs.title: Dominican Republic Defensive Coach
jobs.description_text: DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW: The Player Development department is dedicated to fostering the comprehensive growth of our minor league players. Our mission is to advance the Boston Red Sox in pursuit of World Championships through a comprehensive and collaborative player development system. Our approach involves the creation of world-class player programs and efficiently scaling them across our player pool. Collaborating closely with other departments, we establish effective frameworks for exploration, learning, and development. Additionally, we work closely with Amateur Scouting, International Scouting, and Pro Scouting to ensure seamless player transitions into the Red Sox organization. Simply put, we strive to be the standard in player and staff development. POSITION OVERVIEW: The DR Defensive Coach is primarily responsible for the on-field implementation, execution, and tracking of evidence-based defensive and baserunning development for academy players in the DR. The candidate will play a key role in executing daily training initiatives and translating organizational priorities into a high-quality on-field training environment. This role also includes the opportunity to impact player development through player education, participating in player meetings, player feedback and other responsibilities that support the staff and players at the academy. As part of the responsibilities, the DR Defensive Coach will collaborate with players and field staff to maximize departmental buy-in.

jobs.title: DR Academy Hitting Coach
jobs.description_text: DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW: The Player Development department is dedicated to fostering the comprehensive growth of our minor league players. POSITION OVERVIEW: The DR Academy Hitting Coach will work closely with the other hitting coaches, the Director of Hitting Development, and other essential staff to help implement and track player-specific offensive development plans. This is a hands-on, uniformed position that supports the daily operations related to improving player performance. We are seeking someone who is organized, detail-oriented, curious, and data-driven, with strong interpersonal and teamwork skills. The candidate should also be comfortable in a fast-paced environment, working closely with players, coaches, and other departments to ensure player success. This position will be based out of our academy in the Dominican Republic.

jobs.title: Minor League Assistant Strength and Conditioning Coach
jobs.description_text: DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW: As an organization, we place a substantial emphasis on maximizing player value through purposeful, long-term development. The Strength and Conditioning department is responsible for player evaluation, programming, innovation, and collaboration between all other departments and stakeholders to optimize on-field performance. POSITION OVERVIEW: The Boston Red Sox are looking for Assistant Strength and Conditioning Coaches for the upcoming 2027 season. Assistant S&C Coaches will report to Fort Myers, FL for Spring Training and then travel with an affiliate team until the end of the team’s competitive season. Assistant S&C Coaches will be notified of their affiliate assignments during Spring Training at the discretion of the organization. Coaches will assist in the implementation of the Boston Red Sox Strength and Conditioning, Baseball Sciences, Medical, and Nutrition programs. Travel: This position will be based out of Fort Myers, Florida during Minor League Spring Training, then based out of an assigned affiliate for the duration of the competitive season. Travel to all away games is required. Occasional travel may be required to other Red Sox affiliates, staff events, and educational opportunities.

From designing and developing customized IoT solutions to implementing and managing them seamlessly, Concept Reply helps customers unlock the potential of IoT. Working closely with leadership, this person will also help improve processes and support the continued growth of the business.

You will support the team’s migration of HMSSimBlocks capabilities to HMSF by helping implement baseline adapters, port selected modules, test functionality, and maintain compatibility for programs that continue to use HMSSimBlocks. jobs.description_text: Job Description: As a Environmental Test Technician at Shield AI, you'll prepare, execute, and manage environmental tests on electronic flight hardware across the VBAT and XBAT aircraft, ensuring it meets performance requirements through rigorous thermal, vibration, shock, humidity, and altitude testing. This is a highly hands-on role. Working with design and reliability stakeholders, you'll help define test plans — stress profiles, setup, and instrumentation — then bring them to the bench: installing test articles, instrumenting hardware with thermocouples, accelerometers, strain gauges, and humidity sensors, configuring data acquisition, and programming and loading chambers. You'll frequently run several campaigns at once, prioritizing tests as needed to keep them moving without compromising data quality. Once tests are running, you'll operate the equipment, monitor for and investigate failures, and reduce and document results in clear reports — including the plots and visualizations stakeholders rely on to make disposition and qualification decisions. You'll work with cutting-edge deep-tech hardware, collaborate across disciplines, and directly influence product quality and long-term reliability over the vehicles’ lifecycles.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next. These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide. This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job. The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next. We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.
